create_ProximitySampler: create a ProximitySampler that loads a cosine similarity matrix and samples batches by proximity
iterate_ProximitySampler: iterate over a ProximitySampler to get indices of nearest neighbors in feature space
filter_ProximitySampler_with_idxs: create a ProximitySampler with optional idxs to filter the cosine similarity matrix
get_ProximitySampler_length: get the total number of samples from a ProximitySampler using its length method
review_ProximitySampler_class: review the ProximitySampler class that samples data batches based on cosine similarity proximity
